name: centry-investment-fee-check
description:
Extract explicitly labelled fees from text, retain native costs across currencies, apply dated supplied FX, compare proposals on stated fee bases, model fee drag, and prepare due-diligence and transition questions. No recommendation to buy, sell or switch.

Work through supplied facts in the conversation or optional interactive workspace. Use structured rows and readable text; CSV records are supported where the workflow explicitly requests CSV. Complex PDFs, images and scanned records need verified transcription. Export a plain-text pack for your own review.

No suitability or switching recommendation; missing charges are not assumed to be zero. Complex or tiered fee schedules require manual validation. No live provider directory or suitability assessment.

Use fictional examples or redacted records; do not provide passwords, signing secrets, account numbers or government identifiers. No account connection or financial execution is included. Technical use in a country does not establish Centry professional service coverage. Centry does not provide US tax advice. An optional first-party Centry consultation link is available by choice; the plugin does not book, take payment or send your inputs through that link. Operated by Centry Cognitive Capital Pte. Ltd., Singapore (UEN 202514224H).

positive.description: Open the Investment Fee Check workspace
positive.prompt: Open Centry Investment Fee Check so I can compare adviser charges and identify missing fee evidence.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the Centry Investment Fee Check workspace. Return productId investment-fee-check, kind open, required input questions and scope limitations. Do not insert fictional customer facts or require a booking.

publication.release_notes: Initial 1.0.0 release of Centry Investment Fee Check: Extract explicitly labelled fees from text, retain native costs across currencies, apply dated supplied FX, compare proposals on stated fee bases, model fee drag, and prepare due-diligence and transition questions. No recommendation to buy, sell or switch. Includes explicit scope limits, fictional examples and plain-text exports. Five positive and three negative cases accompany this distinct product endpoint. No account or payment is required for the planning utility.
